name: Helicone
oneLine: Open-source AI gateway and LLM observability platform that logs requests via proxy or async SDK.

selfHostStack.value: Docker Compose: web, Jawn API, Postgres, ClickHouse, MinIO, Redis, Kafka, Cloudflare Worker proxies; all-in-one image

selfHostLicence.value: Apache-2.0; Helm chart for production is offered to Enterprise customers on request

cloudFree.value: Hobby $0: 10,000 requests, 1 GB storage, 1 seat, 7-day retention

cloudPaidFrom.value: Pro $79/month plus usage-based pricing; 7-day free trial

otel.value: Not documented: no direct OTLP endpoint found; @helicone/async (OpenLLMetry-based) exports OTLP/HTTP traces
otel.short: No OTLP endpoint; async SDK only

sql.value: Yes: HQL runs SQL in the dashboard and via REST API; available to selected workspaces

mcp.value: MCP server with two data-query tools: query_requests and query_sessions; no write tools documented

onlineEvals.value: No: docs say Helicone does not run evaluations; scores are submitted via API or dashboard

datasetsExperiments.value: Datasets: curated logged requests, JSONL/CSV export; Experiments feature deprecated, removal dated Sept 1, 2025

promptManagement.value: Yes: prompt versions with rollback and per-environment deployment through the AI Gateway

gateway.value: Yes: OpenAI-compatible AI Gateway, 100+ providers, routing, fallbacks; all-in-one self-host image excludes proxying

alerts.value: Alerts on error rate, cost, latency, tokens, request count to email and Slack; webhooks not mentioned in docs

codingAgents.value: Logs Claude Code through a base-URL proxy and Codex CLI through the AI Gateway

chooseThem: Gateway with a base-URL change, 100+ providers, automatic fallbacks and caching
Apache-2.0 code with a hosted cloud, so you can start on cloud and keep a self-host option
Request-level cost and latency tracking and prompt deployment to environments through the gateway
Entry plan at $79/month plus a free Hobby tier for small projects
